summary_en: Cominix raised interim dividend to 30 yen per share from 25 yen, effective December 9, 2026, and revised full-year FY2027 dividend guidance to 60 yen (30 yen interim + 30 yen year-end) from 50 yen. Operating profit forecast lifted 50% to 2.4 billion yen on demand surge in semiconductor equipment and cutting tools.
title_en: Notice Regarding Variance between 2nd Quarter FY2027 Consolidated and Non-Consolidated Earnings Forecasts and Actual Results, Revision of Full-Year Earnings Forecasts, Interim Dividend Increase, and Year-End Dividend Forecast Revision
translation_en_brief: Cominix announced an increase in interim dividend to 30 yen per share, up from 25 yen previously forecast, effective December 9, 2026. The company also raised its full-year FY2027 dividend guidance to 60 yen per share (comprising 30 yen interim and 30 yen year-end) from an earlier forecast of 50 yen. This reflects strong performance in the second quarter ended September 30, 2026, where actual interim net profit reached 875 million yen against a forecast of 600 million yen, a 45.8% upside. The dividend increase was supported by robust revenue and improved profitability across the company's operating segments. Revenue exceeded forecast by 5.7% to 25.4 billion yen in the interim period, driven by advance purchases linked to a major cutting tool manufacturer's price revisions, robust demand from semiconductor manufacturing equipment operations (particularly the KMS division), and growth in the company's overseas mineral resource business. Operating profit surged 44.8% above forecast to 1.45 billion yen, reflecting both the revenue outperformance and margin improvements. Based on interim results and current order environment, the company also raised full-year consolidated operating profit guidance by 50% to 2.4 billion yen from 1.6 billion yen previously.
